text:
Elaine (Support): Multiple customers reporting sudden 5xx / gateway timeouts for hosted inference since ~08:05 UTC. Hits mainly on /v1/generate-hosted. Example errors: "upstream error: backend 502", "gateway timeout 504". Filing INC-7832. Any rollout happening around then?
Ravi (Eng): We kicked a small canary this morning for header-normalizer changes, yep. tag=canary/normalize-headers commit=abc123.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 5098765300 tag=canary/normalize-headers slice=10% commit=abc123
Jonah (Oncall): Looking at gateway logs — spike aligns with canary start. Quick sample from gateway:
```
[2026-03-17T08:06:12Z] gateway route=/v1/generate-hosted status=502 error="panic: header normalize: auth length>200" request_id=req_01F7XKJ2
```
Jonah (Oncall): Also seeing a stream of 500s with stack traces pointing to header normalizer.
Kai (SRE): Can we repro locally with long auth headers? Ravi, did the normalizer change alter behavior for long or empty tokens?
Ravi (Eng): Yes — I added stricter normalization to trim whitespace and reject ultra-long values. I missed an early-return when token is empty which triggers a panic on validation path. That change is only in canary.
Jonah (Oncall): If that's it, we should rollback the canary slice to 0 immediately. Rolling back now (will update ts).
Elaine (Support): I'll notify affected customers that we're investigating and recommend temporary workarounds (shorter headers or using session refs). Preparing status page update.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for tag=canary/normalize-headers slice=0 at 5098765720
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 5098765720 slice=0 traffic=stable
Ravi (Eng): Sorry — my change should have been defensive. I'll open a hotfix PR with a safe-guard that returns 400 instead of panicking and add unit test for auth token length. Backport to stable if needed.
Jonah (Oncall): Post-rollback metrics trending down. Need to watch for 10 mins. If stable, we'll close incident and follow up with root cause and postmortem.
Elaine (Support): Will send customer updates and include temporary credits if SLA impacted. Ticket INC-7832 updated.
Ravi (Eng): Working on PR now, will ping when it's merged. Thanks for quick rollback. :thumbsup:
Kai (SRE): Follow-ups: add canary smoke for header edgecases, add an e2e test for very long/empty auth header, and include header sanitizer fallback.
Elaine (Support): Copy. I'll coordinate customer comms and ask billing for any required credits.
Jonah (Oncall): Closing active surge — continuing to monitor. Patch + tests tracked in ENG-998.
